current.text: He has a deal of about 10 million USD per year with four more years left.
He is a valuable shooter but does not fit Milwaukee's new direction, so he is a trade candidate.
Milwaukee's backcourt is crowded. Green competes for guard minutes with Rollins, Herro, Porter, Jakucionis, Burries and Trent.
He is not in the projected opening starting lineup of Rollins, Herro, Jaquez, Kuzma and Turner.
Experts expect Milwaukee to focus more on developing young players as the season goes on, which would cut veteran minutes.
New coach Taylor Jenkins might use a deep rotation, and experts have low confidence in how Bucks minutes will be split.
Experts expect the Bucks to be a bad team, at about 33 wins.
Experts say the roster needs trades to consolidate, so more moves are likely.

durable.text: He is a very good shooter who does not add much else. Threes are his only category above the pool average.
